rows.label: Annual Land Tax
rows.value: Annual Land Tax on allocated land: the standard rate is prescribed by the President of the Lands Court with the approval of the Governor and reviewed every twelve months; due to the Registrar of the Court by 31 December; if unpaid six months after a written notice, the land reverts to the Island Council
rows.note: The current standard rate is not in the ordinance and was not found on government.pn; the 30 cents per square metre in section 9(1) applied only for the first twelve months after the suspension date. No start date for 2026: stored from 1 January 2026.

rows.label: Landing fees (entry clearance)
rows.value: Landing fees on entry clearance under the Immigration Control Ordinance: an applicant unable to pay the required landing fee can be refused; parents and children of people lawfully residing on Pitcairn are exempt from entry clearance landing fees other than settlement clearance fees
rows.note: The amounts are set outside the ordinance (the Government's visiting-vessel guide lists landing fees and a passenger head levy, but its text could not be read) and are not stored.
